name: Orca Mascots
description: Twenty glossy marine mascots for your Orca bots. Pick one, choose a background and shape, and save it as a bot picture.

cover.alt: Twenty glossy marine animal mascots shown as round avatars on pastel backgrounds.

screenshots.alt: The Orca Mascots sidebar panel beside avatars it saved: a square beluga, a round humpback and four smaller ones.
screenshots.caption: Pick a mascot, a background and a shape, then save a PNG.

screenshots.alt: Fifteen of the mascots as square bot pictures on solid and gradient backgrounds.
screenshots.caption: Twenty mascots, ready to upload as bot pictures.
